edges.notes: VS Code debug UI is a DAP client; protocol is external specification.
Cursor inherits VS Code–lineage debug/DAP patterns; parity is version-specific.
Complementary planes: language intelligence vs debug control in the same stack.
Agent tool host may coexist with DAP-capable editor; do not merge protocol semantics.
Debug sessions resolve symbols from ELF objects; DWARF often lives in ELF sections.
Many DAP adapters use GDB as the debug engine for C/C++ on Linux.
lldb-dap and CodeLLDB-class adapters expose LLDB through DAP.
